decision: Do not adopt: combined source/isolation change improves DC but retained-network high-drive transient regulation still fails. Resolve feedback dynamics and loaded settling before compensation-layout integration.
limitations: Nominal DC only with ideal reference, bias and enable.
New source fingers and PMOS link include device junctions, but new routing and well extraction are absent.
Loop stability, reset, unpowered behavior, terminal exposure, current capacity and area remain open.
